refused.title: Notifications are not open to you
refused.body: Your roles do not include Home (home.view). Ask an administrator if you need it.

held.offline: Offline — this waits until you are back online.
held.unknown: The count is not known yet.

ALL.label: All
ALL.hint: everything you were told, records you follow included

ASSIGNMENT.label: Assigned to me
ASSIGNMENT.hint: tasks, alerts and rows given to you

APPROVAL.label: Approvals
APPROVAL.hint: requests for your yes, and your requests decided

SYSTEM.label: System
SYSTEM.hint: alerts of the exception rules and finished jobs

empty.title: No notifications.
empty.body: You are told about mentions, assignments, approvals and records you follow.

SNOOZED.title: Nothing snoozed.
SNOOZED.body: A snoozed notification comes back by itself at its time, or when something changes on its record.

DONE.title: Nothing done yet.
DONE.body: What you mark done (E) is kept here; put it back on the list from here.

offline.title: Offline
offline.body: The list stays readable; marking read, done or snoozed waits until you are back online.

keys.snooze: Snooze until a time or new activity
keys.mute: Mute the record: no more news of it (a mention still reaches you)
keys.allRead: Mark all read in this tab

notice.snoozed_one: {count} snoozed: it comes back at its time.
notice.snoozed_other: {count} snoozed: they come back at their time.
notice.snoozedChange_one: {count} snoozed until something changes on its record.
notice.snoozedChange_other: {count} snoozed until something changes on their records.
notice.muted: {record} muted: its news no longer reaches you (a mention still does).
notice.muteForbidden: You may not follow {record} any more.
notice.allRead: Everything in this tab is marked read.

problem.read: The list could not be read. Try again.
problem.offline: No connection to the server. Try again when you are back online.
problem.signedOut: Your session ended. Sign in again.
problem.failed: This could not be sent. Try again.
problem.changed: Something changed meanwhile. The list was read again.
problem.invalid: This could not be done as asked. The list was read again.

digest.title: Notification preferences
digest.body: Quiet by default: everything stays in the app, and nothing is e-mailed until you turn on your daily digest. The digest is one e-mail a day with what you have not looked at yet.
digest.offWords: Daily digest off: nothing is e-mailed
digest.later: Each kind by app, e-mail or push, instantly or daily, comes later; until then only this digest reaches your e-mail.

problem.changed: Your preferences changed meanwhile (in another tab?). They were read again: look, then save.
problem.invalid: These preferences could not be saved as they are.

saved.on: Daily digest on: it is e-mailed at {time} on the days you chose.
saved.off: Daily digest off: nothing is e-mailed.

following.note: {actor} wrote a note on {record}, which you follow
following.mail_in: A reply arrived on {record}, which you follow
following.mail_out: {actor} sent a message on {record}, which you follow

approval.nudged: {actor} reminds you: quote {record} still waits for your approval

plant.reported: A machine problem was reported on {record}: {title}
plant.unsafe: {record} was marked unsafe ({title}): it stays do-not-use until a technician signs it safe
